product: G mice (HID++ 2.0, Lightspeed / Bolt receiver, cable or Bluetooth)
works: feature lookup through IRoot getFeature (no fixed indexes)
battery: 0x1004 unified (percent when the mouse reports it, level, charging), else 0x1000 (percent, charging), else 0x1001 (voltage and charging only)
DPI (0x2201): current value, slider over the mouse's own range and step, or a choice from its own list
report rate: 0x8061 (125-8000 Hz) on 8K mice, else 0x8060, from the mouse's own list
onboard / host mode read, and switched only as an explicit setting (0x8100 mode functions only)

onboard profile select: the profile count from 0x8100 fn 0x00 (libratbag), current profile fn 0x40, select fn 0x30 [00, number]; only offered once the mouse's profile numbering is known (G502 X family 1-based per libratbag's quirk, otherwise learnt from a 0 or top reading)
DPI stage (which of the profile's 5 DPI slots is in use): 0x8100 fn 0xB0 / 0xC0 (libratbag)
lift-off distance low / medium / high on mice with 0x2202 and its LOD bit (Solaar ExtendedAdjustableDpi), the DPI rewritten as read
never looked up or sent: DFU, reset, OOB state, force pairing, and since 22 Oct 2026 BLE pre-pairing 0x1816 and Lightspeed pairing 0x0309 (Solaar hidpp20_constants.py)
every write read back; DPI, report rate and lift-off written only in host mode; every write refused while G HUB (lghub*.exe) runs

22 Oct 2026: models covered by their libratbag ids alone (data/devices @ 8235b5bb): USB ids in WIRED, Bluetooth ids G603 b01c, G604 b024, G705 b02e; every feature is still found at connect, so a setting appears only if the mouse answers it. G502 HERO, G502 Proteus Spectrum and G604 read their profile 1-based (libratbag INDEX_OFFSET)

22 Oct 2026 (problem report DeviceHub-support#2): on a receiver every slot 1-6 is asked read-only (ping, getFeature 0x2201, the kind from DEVICE_NAME 0x0005 fn 0x20 per Solaar hidpp20.py get_kind) and only a slot whose device has 0x2201 is run; a keyboard or other device there is left alone with no error (the driver lets go of the receiver), nothing answering is the normal asleep state, and one driver owns each slot when several Logitech drivers share a receiver
doesNotWork: mouse name and firmware version (0x0005 / 0x0003 function codes not in the sheet)

which model is on a receiver: the pairing table (HID++ 1.0 register 0xB5, Solaar receiver.py / libratbag hidpp10.c / Linux hid-logitech-dj.c) is requested with a SHORT report on the receiver's short-report collection, which this driver does not open, and the never list names receiver pairing registers; an empty slot and a sleeping mouse both read as asleep
firmware updates, DFU, resets and pairing (never: they stay in Logitech's own app)
receivers C541 / C545 / C547: the sheet names them G915 keyboard receivers (OpenRGB), so they are not offered for a mouse
editing onboard profiles (the DPI of each stage, buttons, sleep timer, lights): profile memory writes rewrite flash and are never sent
lighting: 0x8071 has no read-back; 0x8070 effect parameter layouts are not in the sheet
button remapping: 0x1B04 remap targets and its read reply layout are not in the sheet
angle snapping and surface tuning: no documented bytes (0x2240 is an id only)
mice with only 0x2202 and no 0x2201 (DPI is read through 0x2201)

Bluetooth: only G603 (b01c), G604 (b024) and G705 (b02e) have a documented Bluetooth id (libratbag @ 8235b5bb); no other covered mouse has one in any source read. On Bluetooth the report rate is not looked up, read or written
G602: its own receiver (C537) is not one this driver opens, and libratbag reads its DPI list differently (HIDPP20_QUIRK_G602)

tested.how: tests/sim-logitech.mjs: a simulated HID++ 2.0 mouse answering as docs/brands/logitech.md documents. Never run on a real mouse.
